panels.title: Workloads

targets.expr: count(fyno:workload_replicas_desired{namespace=~"$namespace", workload_type=~"$workload_type", workload=~"$workload"})

panels.description: Deployments + StatefulSets + DaemonSets matching the filters

panels.title: Degraded workloads

targets.expr: count(fyno:workload_replicas_desired{namespace=~"$namespace", workload_type=~"$workload_type", workload=~"$workload"} - on (namespace, workload, workload_type) fyno:workload_replicas_available{namespace=~"$namespace", workload_type=~"$workload_type", workload=~"$workload"} > 0) or vector(0)

panels.description: Workloads with fewer ready replicas than desired

targets.expr: sum(clamp_min(fyno:workload_replicas_desired{namespace=~"$namespace", workload_type=~"$workload_type", workload=~"$workload"} - on (namespace, workload, workload_type) fyno:workload_replicas_available{namespace=~"$namespace", workload_type=~"$workload_type", workload=~"$workload"}, 0)) or vector(0)

count((kube_pod_status_phase{namespace=~"$namespace", phase="Running"} == 1) * on (namespace, pod) fyno:workload_pod:owner{namespace=~"$namespace", workload_type=~"$workload_type", workload=~"$workload"}) or vector(0)
round(sum(fyno:workload_restarts_1h{namespace=~"$namespace", workload_type=~"$workload_type", workload=~"$workload"})) or vector(0)

panels.title: Nodes ready

targets.expr: count(kube_node_status_condition{condition="Ready", status="true"} == 1) or vector(0)

panels.description: Cluster-wide

panels.title: Ready replicas per workload

targets.expr: sum by (workload) (fyno:workload_replicas_available{namespace=~"$namespace", workload_type=~"$workload_type", workload=~"$workload"})

panels.description: A step up/down is a scale event (HPA, manual or rollout).

targets.expr: sum by (workload) (fyno:workload_replicas_desired{namespace=~"$namespace", workload_type=~"$workload_type", workload=~"$workload"})

panels.title: Replica status (now)

targets.expr: max by (namespace, workload, workload_type) (fyno:workload_replicas_desired{namespace=~"$namespace", workload_type=~"$workload_type", workload=~"$workload"})
max by (namespace, workload, workload_type) (fyno:workload_replicas_available{namespace=~"$namespace", workload_type=~"$workload_type", workload=~"$workload"})

clamp_min(fyno:workload_replicas_desired{namespace=~"$namespace", workload_type=~"$workload_type", workload=~"$workload"} - on (namespace, workload, workload_type) fyno:workload_replicas_available{namespace=~"$namespace", workload_type=~"$workload_type", workload=~"$workload"}, 0)

panels.description: One row per workload. Sorted with the most unavailable replicas first.

panels.title: Scale events in selected time range

targets.expr: changes(fyno:workload_replicas_desired{namespace=~"$namespace", workload_type=~"$workload_type", workload=~"$workload"}[$__range])
min_over_time(fyno:workload_replicas_desired{namespace=~"$namespace", workload_type=~"$workload_type", workload=~"$workload"}[$__range])
max_over_time(fyno:workload_replicas_desired{namespace=~"$namespace", workload_type=~"$workload_type", workload=~"$workload"}[$__range])
max by (namespace, workload, workload_type) (fyno:workload_replicas_desired{namespace=~"$namespace", workload_type=~"$workload_type", workload=~"$workload"})

panels.description: How often the desired replica count changed inside the dashboard time range, with min / max / current.

panels.title: Horizontal Pod Autoscalers

targets.expr: max by (namespace, horizontalpodautoscaler) (kube_horizontalpodautoscaler_status_current_replicas{namespace=~"$namespace"})
max by (namespace, horizontalpodautoscaler) (kube_horizontalpodautoscaler_status_desired_replicas{namespace=~"$namespace"})
max by (namespace, horizontalpodautoscaler) (kube_horizontalpodautoscaler_spec_min_replicas{namespace=~"$namespace"})
max by (namespace, horizontalpodautoscaler) (kube_horizontalpodautoscaler_spec_max_replicas{namespace=~"$namespace"})

100 * max by (namespace, horizontalpodautoscaler) (kube_horizontalpodautoscaler_status_current_replicas{namespace=~"$namespace"}) / max by (namespace, horizontalpodautoscaler) (kube_horizontalpodautoscaler_spec_max_replicas{namespace=~"$namespace"})
max by (namespace, horizontalpodautoscaler, scaletargetref_kind, scaletargetref_name) (kube_horizontalpodautoscaler_info{namespace=~"$namespace"})

panels.description: Empty if there are no HPAs. 'Of max %' near 100 means the autoscaler has no headroom left.

targets.expr: max by (horizontalpodautoscaler) (kube_horizontalpodautoscaler_status_current_replicas{namespace=~"$namespace"})

sum by (workload) (clamp_min(fyno:workload_replicas_desired{namespace=~"$namespace", workload_type=~"$workload_type", workload=~"$workload"} - on (namespace, workload, workload_type) fyno:workload_replicas_available{namespace=~"$namespace", workload_type=~"$workload_type", workload=~"$workload"}, 0))

panels.title: Workload load - every workload, highest first
CPU by workload (all, descending)

targets.expr: max by (namespace, workload, workload_type) (fyno:workload_cpu_usage_cores{namespace=~"$namespace", workload_type=~"$workload_type", workload=~"$workload"})
max by (namespace, workload, workload_type) (fyno:workload_cpu_requests_cores{namespace=~"$namespace", workload_type=~"$workload_type", workload=~"$workload"})
max by (namespace, workload, workload_type) (fyno:workload_cpu_limits_cores{namespace=~"$namespace", workload_type=~"$workload_type", workload=~"$workload"})

100 * fyno:workload_cpu_usage_cores{namespace=~"$namespace", workload_type=~"$workload_type", workload=~"$workload"} / on (namespace, workload, workload_type) fyno:workload_cpu_requests_cores{namespace=~"$namespace", workload_type=~"$workload_type", workload=~"$workload"}
count by (namespace, workload, workload_type) (fyno:workload_pod:owner{namespace=~"$namespace", workload_type=~"$workload_type", workload=~"$workload"})

panels.description: Every workload, highest CPU first. '% of request' above 100 = using more than requested; blank = no request set.

panels.title: Memory by workload (all, descending)

targets.expr: max by (namespace, workload, workload_type) (fyno:workload_memory_working_set_bytes{namespace=~"$namespace", workload_type=~"$workload_type", workload=~"$workload"})
max by (namespace, workload, workload_type) (fyno:workload_memory_requests_bytes{namespace=~"$namespace", workload_type=~"$workload_type", workload=~"$workload"})
max by (namespace, workload, workload_type) (fyno:workload_memory_limits_bytes{namespace=~"$namespace", workload_type=~"$workload_type", workload=~"$workload"})

100 * fyno:workload_memory_working_set_bytes{namespace=~"$namespace", workload_type=~"$workload_type", workload=~"$workload"} / on (namespace, workload, workload_type) fyno:workload_memory_limits_bytes{namespace=~"$namespace", workload_type=~"$workload_type", workload=~"$workload"}
count by (namespace, workload, workload_type) (fyno:workload_pod:owner{namespace=~"$namespace", workload_type=~"$workload_type", workload=~"$workload"})

panels.description: Every workload, highest memory (working set) first. '% of limit' close to 100 = OOMKill risk; blank = no limit set.

targets.expr: sum by (workload) (fyno:workload_cpu_usage_cores{namespace=~"$namespace", workload_type=~"$workload_type", workload=~"$workload"})
sum by (workload) (fyno:workload_memory_working_set_bytes{namespace=~"$namespace", workload_type=~"$workload_type", workload=~"$workload"})

panels.title: CPU usage vs request (%)

targets.expr: 100 * fyno:workload_cpu_usage_cores{namespace=~"$namespace", workload_type=~"$workload_type", workload=~"$workload"} / on (namespace, workload, workload_type) fyno:workload_cpu_requests_cores{namespace=~"$namespace", workload_type=~"$workload_type", workload=~"$workload"}

panels.description: >100% = using more than requested; very low = over-provisioned.

panels.title: Memory vs limit (%)

targets.expr: 100 * fyno:workload_memory_working_set_bytes{namespace=~"$namespace", workload_type=~"$workload_type", workload=~"$workload"} / on (namespace, workload, workload_type) fyno:workload_memory_limits_bytes{namespace=~"$namespace", workload_type=~"$workload_type", workload=~"$workload"}

panels.description: Close to 100% = OOMKill risk. Only workloads with a memory limit appear.

panels.title: CPU throttling (% of CFS periods throttled)

targets.expr: 100 * fyno:workload_cpu_throttled_ratio{namespace=~"$namespace", workload_type=~"$workload_type", workload=~"$workload"}

panels.description: Sustained throttling means the CPU limit is too low for the load.

panels.title: Pod restarts per workload (rolling 1h)

targets.expr: round(sum by (workload) (fyno:workload_restarts_1h{namespace=~"$namespace", workload_type=~"$workload_type", workload=~"$workload"} > 0))

panels.description: Crash loops and OOM kills show up here.

targets.expr: sum by (workload) (fyno:workload_network_receive_bytes_rate{namespace=~"$namespace", workload_type=~"$workload_type", workload=~"$workload"})
sum by (workload) (fyno:workload_network_transmit_bytes_rate{namespace=~"$namespace", workload_type=~"$workload_type", workload=~"$workload"})

panels.title: Pods - per workload (follows the namespace / type / workload / pod filters)
Pods (all, highest CPU first)

targets.expr: (sum by (namespace, pod) (rate(container_cpu_usage_seconds_total{container!="", container!="POD", namespace=~"$namespace"}[$__rate_interval]))) * on (namespace, pod) group_left (workload, workload_type) fyno:workload_pod:owner{namespace=~"$namespace", workload_type=~"$workload_type", workload=~"$workload", pod=~"$pod"}

(100 * sum by (namespace, pod) (rate(container_cpu_usage_seconds_total{container!="", container!="POD", namespace=~"$namespace"}[$__rate_interval])) / on (namespace, pod) sum by (namespace, pod) (kube_pod_container_resource_requests{resource="cpu", namespace=~"$namespace"} and on (namespace, pod, container) (kube_pod_container_status_running == 1))) * on (namespace, pod) group_left (workload, workload_type) fyno:workload_pod:owner{namespace=~"$namespace", workload_type=~"$workload_type", workload=~"$workload", pod=~"$pod"}

(sum by (namespace, pod) (container_memory_working_set_bytes{container!="", container!="POD", namespace=~"$namespace"})) * on (namespace, pod) group_left (workload, workload_type) fyno:workload_pod:owner{namespace=~"$namespace", workload_type=~"$workload_type", workload=~"$workload", pod=~"$pod"}

(100 * sum by (namespace, pod) (container_memory_working_set_bytes{container!="", container!="POD", namespace=~"$namespace"}) / on (namespace, pod) sum by (namespace, pod) (kube_pod_container_resource_limits{resource="memory", namespace=~"$namespace"} and on (namespace, pod, container) (kube_pod_container_status_running == 1))) * on (namespace, pod) group_left (workload, workload_type) fyno:workload_pod:owner{namespace=~"$namespace", workload_type=~"$workload_type", workload=~"$workload", pod=~"$pod"}

(sum by (namespace, pod) (increase(kube_pod_container_status_restarts_total{namespace=~"$namespace"}[1h]))) * on (namespace, pod) group_left (workload, workload_type) fyno:workload_pod:owner{namespace=~"$namespace", workload_type=~"$workload_type", workload=~"$workload", pod=~"$pod"}

(max by (namespace, pod) (kube_pod_status_ready{namespace=~"$namespace", condition="true"})) * on (namespace, pod) group_left (workload, workload_type) fyno:workload_pod:owner{namespace=~"$namespace", workload_type=~"$workload_type", workload=~"$workload", pod=~"$pod"}

(time() - max by (namespace, pod) (kube_pod_start_time{namespace=~"$namespace"})) * on (namespace, pod) group_left (workload, workload_type) fyno:workload_pod:owner{namespace=~"$namespace", workload_type=~"$workload_type", workload=~"$workload", pod=~"$pod"}

(max by (namespace, pod, node) (kube_pod_info{namespace=~"$namespace"})) * on (namespace, pod) group_left (workload, workload_type) fyno:workload_pod:owner{namespace=~"$namespace", workload_type=~"$workload_type", workload=~"$workload", pod=~"$pod"}

panels.description: One row per pod with its workload, node, live CPU / memory, restarts and readiness. Click a column header to re-sort.

targets.expr: sum by (pod) ((sum by (namespace, pod) (rate(container_cpu_usage_seconds_total{container!="", container!="POD", namespace=~"$namespace"}[$__rate_interval]))) * on (namespace, pod) fyno:workload_pod:owner{namespace=~"$namespace", workload_type=~"$workload_type", workload=~"$workload", pod=~"$pod"})

sum by (pod) ((sum by (namespace, pod) (container_memory_working_set_bytes{container!="", container!="POD", namespace=~"$namespace"})) * on (namespace, pod) fyno:workload_pod:owner{namespace=~"$namespace", workload_type=~"$workload_type", workload=~"$workload", pod=~"$pod"})

sum by (pod) ((sum by (namespace, pod) (rate(container_network_receive_bytes_total{namespace=~"$namespace"}[$__rate_interval]))) * on (namespace, pod) fyno:workload_pod:owner{namespace=~"$namespace", workload_type=~"$workload_type", workload=~"$workload", pod=~"$pod"})

sum by (pod) ((sum by (namespace, pod) (rate(container_network_transmit_bytes_total{namespace=~"$namespace"}[$__rate_interval]))) * on (namespace, pod) fyno:workload_pod:owner{namespace=~"$namespace", workload_type=~"$workload_type", workload=~"$workload", pod=~"$pod"})

panels.title: CPU usage vs request per pod (%)

targets.expr: 100 * sum by (pod) ((sum by (namespace, pod) (rate(container_cpu_usage_seconds_total{container!="", container!="POD", namespace=~"$namespace"}[$__rate_interval]))) * on (namespace, pod) fyno:workload_pod:owner{namespace=~"$namespace", workload_type=~"$workload_type", workload=~"$workload", pod=~"$pod"}) / sum by (pod) ((sum by (namespace, pod) (kube_pod_container_resource_requests{resource="cpu", namespace=~"$namespace"} and on (namespace, pod, container) (kube_pod_container_status_running == 1))) * on (namespace, pod) fyno:workload_pod:owner{namespace=~"$namespace", workload_type=~"$workload_type", workload=~"$workload", pod=~"$pod"})

100 * sum by (pod) ((sum by (namespace, pod) (container_memory_working_set_bytes{container!="", container!="POD", namespace=~"$namespace"})) * on (namespace, pod) fyno:workload_pod:owner{namespace=~"$namespace", workload_type=~"$workload_type", workload=~"$workload", pod=~"$pod"}) / sum by (pod) ((sum by (namespace, pod) (kube_pod_container_resource_limits{resource="memory", namespace=~"$namespace"} and on (namespace, pod, container) (kube_pod_container_status_running == 1))) * on (namespace, pod) fyno:workload_pod:owner{namespace=~"$namespace", workload_type=~"$workload_type", workload=~"$workload", pod=~"$pod"})

panels.title: Services with no ready endpoints

targets.expr: max by (namespace, service, cluster_ip) (kube_service_info{namespace=~"$namespace", external_name=""} unless on (namespace, service) label_replace(kube_endpoint_address{namespace=~"$namespace", ready="true"}, "service", "$1", "endpoint", "(.+)"))

panels.description: Every Service with zero ready pods behind it. Empty = healthy (selector-less / manually managed services may appear).

targets.expr: sum by (endpoint) (kube_endpoint_address{namespace=~"$namespace", ready="true"})

panels.title: Pods not ready

targets.expr: max by (namespace, pod) ((kube_pod_status_ready{namespace=~"$namespace", condition="false"} == 1) unless on (namespace, pod) (kube_pod_status_phase{namespace=~"$namespace", phase="Succeeded"} == 1))

panels.description: Pods that are not Ready (completed Job pods excluded).

panels.title: Last termination reason (containers restarted in range)

targets.expr: max by (namespace, pod, container, reason) (kube_pod_container_status_last_terminated_reason{namespace=~"$namespace"} == 1 and on (namespace, pod, container) (increase(kube_pod_container_status_restarts_total{namespace=~"$namespace"}[$__range]) > 0))

panels.description: OOMKilled / Error / Completed for containers that restarted in the time range.

panels.title: Node CPU usage vs allocatable (%) - whole node

targets.expr: 100 * sum by (node) (rate(container_cpu_usage_seconds_total{id="/"}[$__rate_interval])) / on (node) sum by (node) (kube_node_status_allocatable{resource="cpu"})

panels.description: Real usage of the whole node (all namespaces).

panels.title: Node memory usage vs allocatable (%) - whole node

targets.expr: 100 * sum by (node) (container_memory_working_set_bytes{id="/"}) / on (node) sum by (node) (kube_node_status_allocatable{resource="memory"})

panels.description: Real usage of the whole node (all namespaces).

panels.title: CPU requested by fyno-vks-prod pods vs allocatable (%)

targets.expr: 100 * sum by (node) (kube_pod_container_resource_requests{resource="cpu", namespace=~"$namespace"} and on (namespace, pod, container) (kube_pod_container_status_running == 1)) / on (node) sum by (node) (kube_node_status_allocatable{resource="cpu"})

panels.description: Scheduling pressure from this namespace only (kube-state-metrics is scoped to fyno-vks-prod).

panels.title: Memory requested by fyno-vks-prod pods vs allocatable (%)

targets.expr: 100 * sum by (node) (kube_pod_container_resource_requests{resource="memory", namespace=~"$namespace"} and on (namespace, pod, container) (kube_pod_container_status_running == 1)) / on (node) sum by (node) (kube_node_status_allocatable{resource="memory"})
count by (node) (kube_pod_info{namespace=~"$namespace"})
